'Grief-stricken' Turkish city mourns young victims of school shooting

Thousands attend the funeral of four children killed during a school shooting on April 15, 2026 in the city of Kahramanmaras, in Turkey's southeast. Eight pupils and a teacher were killed when a 14-year-old student opened fire in their classroom, in an attack without precedent in Turkey.

AFP VIDEO
